title: MkDocs Documentation Hooks
summary: This module provides custom MkDocs hooks to enhance documentation generation, including optimizing content for Algolia search and dynamically injecting code snippets from source files into Markdown pages.

nodes.label: Process Page HTML for Algolia
nodes.title: HTML Content Processor
nodes.description: Processes the generated HTML content of a page to clean it up and extract relevant information for Algolia search indexing. It removes presentational elements and reformats code blocks.

nodes.label: Write Algolia Search Records
nodes.title: Algolia Record Writer
nodes.description: Collects all generated Algolia search records and writes them to a JSON file after the MkDocs build process is complete, making them available for Algolia indexing.

nodes.label: Process Page Markdown
nodes.title: Markdown Content Processor
nodes.description: Applies transformations to the raw Markdown content of a page before it is converted to HTML. This includes injecting dynamic code snippets and rendering custom directives.

nodes.label: Configure Jinja2 Environment
nodes.title: Jinja2 Environment Configurator
nodes.description: Modifies the Jinja2 environment used by MkDocs, typically to add global variables like build timestamps or to locate specific asset paths for templating.

nodes.label: Inject Code Snippets
nodes.title: Code Snippet Injector
nodes.description: Scans Markdown content for snippet directives and replaces them with actual code fragments extracted from source files, supporting titles, fragments, and highlighting.

nodes.label: Replace Single Snippet Directive
nodes.title: Snippet Directive Replacer
nodes.description: Handles the replacement of a single snippet directive found in Markdown. It parses the directive, extracts content from the specified file, and formats it for injection.

nodes.label: Parse Snippet Directive
nodes.title: Snippet Directive Parser
nodes.description: Parses a Markdown snippet directive string to extract attributes like file path, title, fragment names, highlight names, and any extra attributes.

nodes.label: Parse Source File Sections
nodes.title: Source File Section Parser
nodes.description: Reads a source code file and identifies named sections and line ranges within it, allowing for selective extraction of code fragments.

nodes.label: Render Snippet Output
nodes.title: Snippet Content Renderer
nodes.description: Generates the final text content of a snippet based on parsed file sections, specified fragments, and highlight ranges, including ellipsis for omitted content.

nodes.label: Format Highlight Specification
nodes.title: Highlight Line Formatter
nodes.description: Converts a list of line range objects into a string format suitable for code block highlighting directives (e.g., '1 3-5 7').

nodes.label: Algolia Search Records
nodes.title: Algolia Search Index Data
nodes.description: Structured data records prepared for upload to Algolia, containing page content, titles, URLs, and ranking information for search indexing.

nodes.label: Source Code File
nodes.title: Code Snippet Source
nodes.description: The original source code file from which snippets are extracted for inclusion in the documentation.

nodes.label: Markdown Content
nodes.title: Raw Markdown Input
nodes.description: The raw Markdown text of a documentation page before any processing or conversion to HTML.

nodes.label: HTML Content
nodes.title: Raw HTML Input
nodes.description: The raw HTML content of a documentation page, typically generated from Markdown, before Algolia-specific processing.

nodes.label: Processed Markdown Output
nodes.title: Transformed Markdown
nodes.description: Markdown content after snippet injection and other transformations, ready for HTML conversion.

nodes.label: Processed HTML Output
nodes.title: Algolia-Ready HTML
nodes.description: HTML content after cleaning and structuring for optimal Algolia search indexing.

nodes.label: Snippet Directive String
nodes.title: Raw Snippet Directive
nodes.description: The string representation of a snippet directive found in Markdown, e.g., '```snippet {path="file.py"}'.

nodes.label: Parsed Snippet Directive
nodes.title: Structured Snippet Directive
nodes.description: An object representing the parsed attributes of a snippet directive, including path, title, fragments, and highlights.

nodes.label: File Section Data
nodes.title: Structured File Content
nodes.description: An internal representation of a source file, mapping named sections to their corresponding line ranges and content.

nodes.label: Rendered Snippet Text
nodes.title: Final Snippet Text
nodes.description: The actual code snippet text, potentially with highlights and ellipses, ready to be inserted into Markdown.

nodes.label: Highlight Line Specification
nodes.title: Highlight Line Ranges
nodes.description: A list of line ranges indicating which lines within a snippet should be highlighted.

nodes.label: MkDocs Page Object
nodes.title: MkDocs Page Context
nodes.description: Represents the current page being processed by MkDocs, providing access to its title, URL, and file information.

nodes.label: MkDocs Config Object
nodes.title: MkDocs Configuration
nodes.description: The global configuration object for the MkDocs build, containing settings and paths.

nodes.label: MkDocs Files Object
nodes.title: MkDocs File Collection
nodes.description: A collection of all files managed by MkDocs during the build process.

nodes.label: Jinja2 Environment
nodes.title: Jinja2 Templating Engine
nodes.description: The templating environment used by MkDocs for rendering pages, allowing for global variable injection.

nodes.label: BeautifulSoup Library
nodes.title: HTML Parsing Library
nodes.description: A Python library used for parsing HTML and XML documents, enabling easy navigation, search, and modification of the parse tree.

nodes.label: File Not Found Error
nodes.title: File System Error
nodes.description: An exception raised when an attempt to access a file or directory fails because it does not exist.

nodes.label: Test Basic Section Parsing
nodes.title: Basic Section Test
nodes.description: Verifies the correct parsing of a source file with a single, basic named section.

nodes.label: Test Multiple Section Ranges
nodes.title: Multi-Range Section Test
nodes.description: Checks the parsing of a section that spans multiple, non-contiguous ranges within a file.

nodes.label: Test Comment Style Sections
nodes.title: Comment Style Section Test
nodes.description: Ensures sections defined using alternative comment styles (e.g., `///`) are correctly parsed.

nodes.label: Test Nested Sections
nodes.title: Nested Section Test
nodes.description: Validates the parsing logic for sections that are nested within other named sections.

nodes.label: Test Extract Entire File
nodes.title: Entire File Extraction Test
nodes.description: Confirms that the entire file content is extracted when no specific fragments are requested.

nodes.label: Test Extract Specific Section
nodes.title: Specific Section Extraction Test
nodes.description: Verifies the extraction of content from a single, named section within a file.

nodes.label: Test Extract Multiple Sections
nodes.title: Multiple Sections Extraction Test
nodes.description: Checks the extraction of content from several distinct named sections, potentially with intervening text.

nodes.label: Test Complicated Snippet Example
nodes.title: Complex Snippet Test
nodes.description: Tests the snippet extraction and rendering logic with overlapping and complex fragment/highlight definitions.

nodes.label: Test Basic Directive Parsing
nodes.title: Basic Directive Test
nodes.description: Confirms the correct parsing of a simple snippet directive with only a path attribute.

nodes.label: Test All Directive Attributes
nodes.title: Full Directive Attributes Test
nodes.description: Validates the parsing of a snippet directive containing all standard attributes (path, title, fragment, highlight).

nodes.label: Test Extra Directive Attributes
nodes.title: Extra Directive Attributes Test
nodes.description: Ensures that custom, non-standard attributes in a snippet directive are correctly parsed and stored.

nodes.label: Test Missing Path Directive
nodes.title: Missing Path Error Test
nodes.description: Verifies that an error is raised when a snippet directive is missing the required 'path' attribute.

nodes.label: Test Directive Whitespace
nodes.title: Directive Whitespace Test
nodes.description: Checks that the snippet directive parser correctly handles varying amounts of whitespace.

nodes.label: Test Single Line Highlight Format
nodes.title: Single Highlight Format Test
nodes.description: Confirms the correct formatting of a single line for code highlighting.

nodes.label: Test Range Highlight Format
nodes.title: Range Highlight Format Test
nodes.description: Verifies the correct formatting of a continuous range of lines for code highlighting.

nodes.label: Test Multiple Highlights Format
nodes.title: Multiple Highlights Format Test
nodes.description: Ensures multiple, possibly disjoint, highlight ranges are correctly formatted into a single string.

nodes.label: Test Basic Snippet Injection
nodes.title: Basic Injection Test
nodes.description: Validates the fundamental process of injecting a simple code snippet into Markdown.

nodes.label: Test Injection with Title
nodes.title: Titled Snippet Injection Test
nodes.description: Checks that snippets are correctly injected and their custom titles are applied.

nodes.label: Test Injection with Fragments
nodes.title: Fragmented Snippet Injection Test
nodes.description: Verifies that only specified fragments of a source file are injected into the Markdown.

nodes.label: Test Injection with Highlights
nodes.title: Highlighted Snippet Injection Test
nodes.description: Ensures that injected snippets correctly include highlight specifications for certain lines.

nodes.label: Test Multiple Snippet Injections
nodes.title: Multi-Snippet Injection Test
nodes.description: Confirms that multiple snippet directives within a single Markdown file are all correctly processed and injected.

nodes.label: Test Injection with Extra Attributes
nodes.title: Extra Attributes Injection Test
nodes.description: Checks that custom attributes specified in snippet directives are passed through to the rendered code block.

nodes.label: Test Empty Highlight Format
nodes.title: Empty Highlight Format Test
nodes.description: Confirms that an empty string is returned when no highlight ranges are provided.

nodes.label: Test Nonexistent File Injection
nodes.title: Nonexistent File Error Test
nodes.description: Verifies that an error is raised when a snippet directive refers to a file that does not exist.
